entries.content: OBS audio mixing 2026: streamer master volume 3-5 dB cao hơn music/game SFX để viewers rõ voice. Audio bitrate: 160 kbps (stereo) cho streaming, 320 kbps cho local recording. Sample rate 48 kHz (match system audio). Voice peak tại -6 dB để có headroom không clipping. Podcast/talking stream: 128 kbps đủ. Common mistakes: sample rate mismatch → audio sync issues. Adjust sync offset trong Advanced Audio Properties nếu cần.

OBS bitrate 2026: 1080p 60fps → 6000-8000 kbps (H.264), 4500 kbps (AV1/HEVC). Twitch cap 6000 kbps cho non-partner, partner rarely benefit >8500 kbps vì Twitch transcodes. YouTube hỗ trợ đến 51000 kbps cho 4K60. Facebook recommends 4000 kbps cho 1080p. Bitrate ≤ 75% upload bandwidth để tránh connection issues. Keyframe interval 2s cho optimal adaptive bitrate switching. Network upload speed cần 2x target bitrate.
比特率：1080p 60fps应使用6000-8000 kbps。如果网络较弱，降低到4500 kbps但质量会下降。

entries.content: OBSオーディオミキシング：ストリーマーのマスター音量を音楽やゲームの効果音よりも3-5dB高くして、視聴者が声をよく聞こえるようにする。
OBS audio mixing: Streamer's master volume should be 3-5dB higher than music/game SFX so viewers can clearly hear the voice.
